# NomadNest

> NomadNest is a global community where travelling Nomads care for pets and homes in exchange for free accommodation. No money changes hands and there are no booking fees — members pay only an annual membership.

## Pages

- [Home](/): How the free care-for-accommodation exchange works.
- [Browse sits](/browse-sits): House and pet sits available worldwide.
- [Browse nomads](/browse-sitters): Verified Nomads available to care for pets and homes.
- [How it works](/how-it-works): Step-by-step guide for Pet Parents and Nomads.
- [Membership](/membership): Annual plans for Nomads, Pet Parents and Combined members.
- [About](/about): Who founded NomadNest and why.
- [Safety](/safety): ID verification, reviews and reporting tools.
- [FAQ](/faq): Common questions about sits, pets and memberships.
- [Contact](/contact): Reach the support team.

## Optional

- [Privacy Policy](/privacy): How member data is handled.
- [Cookie Policy](/cookies): Cookies and similar technologies.
